examples.scenario: Spear phishing email targeting CFO with a malicious invoice attachment to harvest credentials and deploy a remote access trojan (RAT). The attacker used personal information obtained from social media to craft a convincing email impersonating the CEO.

indicators: Email From: ceo@contoso-exec.com (spoofed, recent domain registration from suspicious country)
Attachment: Invoice_78945.xls with embedded malicious macro
Encoded PowerShell command in macro AutoOpen
Unusual HTTP download to 192.168.1.16 (internal IP spoofing attempt) from macro
Use of HTTP instead of HTTPS in URL
SPF pass but domain is newly registered and not related to official company domain
examples.detection_method: Email gateway sandboxing detecting malicious macro behavior, Endpoint detection monitoring process creations triggered by Office apps launching PowerShell with encoded commands, DNS and domain reputation scoring flagging recently created domains with suspicious registrant data, Network IDS detecting HTTP connections to internal IP in macro payload, User education on verifying urgent financial requests via phone or secondary channel.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
